annotations.title: Which insurance plans fertility clinics say they take

description: The insurers and fertility benefits (Progyny, Carrot, WINFertility, Maven, Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare and others) US fertility clinics name on their own websites as in network or accepted, for one state, optionally only the clinics that name one plan. Each answer gives the clinic's own words, its page and the date it was read. A plan a clinic takes can still leave IVF out: the plan's own fertility benefit decides that.

plan.description: Optional insurer or fertility benefit to filter by (for example Progyny, Aetna, TRICARE).

state.description: A US state: its two-letter code (TX) or its name (Texas). DC counts as a state here.
